editorial:
Imagine waking up on a tropical beach after your prison ship sinks, thinking you have finally found freedom. That is exactly where you start with this wild ride. You follow a group of rough prisoners and a doctor who stumble upon a creepy couple living in a big house on a lonely island. At first, it seems like a lucky break, but the vibe quickly shifts from a vacation to a nightmare. You can feel the tension building as the prisoners start vanishing one by one, and you realize that the friendly hosts are hiding something truly gross in their basement.

What really makes this movie work are the weird creature effects and the slow build-up of dread. The acting is a bit over the top, but that just adds to the fun of this old-school horror flick. While some parts drag a bit, the reveal of the fish-people is totally worth the wait. If you love campy monsters and weird science, you should definitely check this out. You can find it by renting it on Apple TV or adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You find out the couple is using a serum to turn humans into fish-people to create a new race. In the final scenes, the doctor discovers the lab and the horrific truth. Everything ends in chaos as the house burns down and the monsters are killed. The few remaining survivors manage to escape the island, leaving the mad scientists and their failed experiments to be destroyed by the fire.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old monster movies and weird B-movie plots.
